verdict.rationale: treg runs a single hosted MCP endpoint (https://treg.to/mcp) that exposes its catalog, so it is a hosted tool gateway, but adding your own APIs is only indirect. `treg upload clis` turns local CLIs into team tools, and vendors can get listed by submitting a pull request to the repo, which then routes calls through treg's MCP and proxy layer without custom protocol code. Missing for 10: any evidence of importing an OpenAPI definition to generate MCP tools, wrapping arbitrary custom code as a hosted MCP server, a dedicated per-API hosted server, and hands-on corroboration that uploaded tools appear over MCP.
